title: Coordinating KestrelCare with the Kestrel Limited Warranty: Starting Amount of a Remainder
content:
**Clause.** For a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts authorization of a repair order that a Kestrel limited warranty decision has already decided, the amount is read from the latest limited warranty decision recorded for the holder — the one with the most recent decision date — taking its repair estimate, the amount it covered, the deductible it applied and its decision. The limited warranty decisions are the repair decisions booked against the vehicle's Vehicle Purchase Agreements purchase order.

The starting amount depends on how the limited warranty decision ended:

- where it approved the repair order and applied a deductible of its own, the starting amount is the estimate less the amount it covered and less that deductible;
- where it approved the repair order without a deductible of its own, the starting amount is the estimate less the amount it covered;
- in every other case — the limited warranty decision did not approve the repair order, or there is none — the starting amount is the full repair estimate.

## Reading the limited warranty decision

| Decision on the limited warranty record | Deductible on that record | Starting amount |
|---|---|---|
| approved | above 0.00 | estimate less covered amount less that deductible |
| approved | 0.00 | estimate less covered amount |
| any denial | any | full estimate |
| no limited warranty decision | — | full estimate |

## Illustrations (hypothetical decisions)

- Estimate 3400.00, covered 2100.00, limited warranty deductible 100.00, approved: starting amount 1200.00.
- Estimate 3400.00, covered 2100.00, no limited warranty deductible, approved: starting amount 1300.00.
- Estimate 3400.00, decision denied on the limited warranty record: starting amount 3400.00.
